reuse.why: Both amount consumers bypass getScheduledAmount, and the preview calculation repeats getApproxNumberThreshold instead of reusing it.

duplication.why: The change adds another missing/number/range dispatch and duplicates the existing approximate-tolerance formula.

placement.why: Schedule amount policy is embedded in API serialization and preview generation instead of centralized in the existing shared schedule helper.

scope.why: All edits concern schedule amount expectations, their API representation, or associated tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate separate amount policies across the API, previews, posting, action synchronization, and the existing helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: scheduleModel.toExternal and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions bypass shared/schedules.ts:getScheduledAmount; the preview also bypasses shared/rules.ts:getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: scheduleModel.toExternal reshapes the existing missing/number/range dispatch using nullish coalescing, while preview generation embeds the existing tolerance calculation inside a larger expression.

abstraction_drift.where: computeSchedulePreviewTransactions gains an isapprox branch; it and scheduleModel.toExternal implement amount policy outside getScheduledAmount, leaving the existing shared definition unchanged.
